== Recovering Cholula Hot Sauce ==
:hot_sauce:cholula:chile:arbol:pequin:

=== References ===

- [[https://chickensaucerecipes.com/cholula-hot-sauce-copycat-recipe/|Cholula Hot Sauce Copycat Recipe: Authentic Mexican Flavor in a Bottle]]
- [[https://cookupp.com/homemade-cholula-hot-sauce-recipe/|5-Minute Homemade Cholula Hot Sauce Recipe]]
- [[https://coolhunting.com/food-drink/cholula-chapala-factory/|Product of the Pepper: Inside Cholula's Chapala Factory]]
- [[https://eathealthy365.com/the-ultimate-homemade-cholula-hot-sauce-clone-recipe/|The Ultimate Homemade Cholula Hot Sauce Clone Recipe]]
- [[https://recipesreverie.com/cholula-hot-sauce/|Cholula Hot Sauce Recipe: Perfect Your Own Fiery Blend]]
- [[https://spicetosauce.com/cholula-hot-sauce-recipe/|Homemade Cholula Hot Sauce Recipe: Enjoy the Authentic Mexican Flavor]]
- [[https://rusticrootsliving.com/how-to-rehydrate-chili-peppers/|Rustic Roots Living, How to Rehydrate Chili Peppers: 3 Easy Methods]]

=== Ingredients ===

- 1-¼ cups water
- ¾ cup apple cider vinegar
- 16 g dried chiles de árbol, stems removed
- 4 g dried Pequín peppers (or more, to taste)
- ½ Tb ground sweet Hungarian paprika
- 1 tsp roasted garlic powder
- ½ tsp toasted onion powder
- ⅛ tsp cumin
- ¼ tsp Mexican oregano
- ¼ tsp black pepper
- 15 g salt
- 0.1–0.2 wt-% xanthan gum

=== Directions ===

1. Rinse chiles.
2. Cut with scissors into large pieces.
3. Combine ingredients in a pint mason jar.
4. Soak until peppers soften (~8 hours).
5. Heat over medium (6) heat to 180 °F (82 °C);
   keep it at that temperature (5, stirring gently) for about 10 minutes.
6. Cover and cool, until no longer scalding hot.
8. Open windows and blend chiles with a small amount of liquid, until smooth.
9. Blend with remaining liquid.
10. Strain and weigh sauce.
11. Return to blender on low and slowly sprinkle 0.1 wt-% xanthan gum.
12. Wait 30 minutes and adjust thickness, if needed,
    with 0.1–0.2 g xanthan gum.
13. Reheat to 180 °F (82 °C), pour into sterilized bottles, cap right away, and
    turn the bottle upside down for a couple of minutes.
14. Refrigerate.

=== Notes ===

- Target 1,000 Scoville Heat Units (SHU)
- Yield is 450–500 g.
- 50/50 white and cider vinegar lacked vinegar flavor.
  Reduce water and shift to apple cider forward.
- Toasted chiles were darker than Cholula and spicier.
  Reduce Pequín, skip toasting, and remove seeds.
  Order fresh chiles de árbol.
- [[https://rusticrootsliving.com/how-to-rehydrate-chili-peppers/|Rustic Roots Living]]
  recommends steeping chiles at room temperature and not boiling
  to retain volatile oils.
  Ten minute hold at 180 °F along with all ingredients should work.
  Consider steeping with all ingredients to merge flavors and hydrate spices.
- Try 2 g Pequín chiles and
  1 cup apple cider vinegar,
  without white vinegar. Still too hot.
- Return chile ratio to 20/5
  and reduce chiles to target 1,000 SHU.
  Increase salt to 15 g, closer to Cholula estimated, 29 g.
  Reduce paprika and switch to sweet
  to retain balance with chiles.
